title: Covering preservation and reflection under a site equivalence
statement: Let C and D be small categories with precoverages J and K, each satisfying HasIsos, composition stability, base-change stability and HasPullbacks [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let e : C ≌ D. Assume for every object W of C and presieve R on W that R in J W implies R.map e.functor in K(e(W)), and for every V of D and presieve S on V that S in K V implies S.map e.inverse in J(e.inverse(V)). Then for every W and R, R in J W iff R.map e.functor in K(e(W)).

source.place: Sites Definition 00VH and Definition 00VU; covering-reflection argument in proof step 1 of lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-invariance-under-site-equivalence

proof.text: Fix W and R. The forward implication is hcover. For the reverse, apply hcover_inv at e(W) to R.map e.functor, obtaining that its further image under e.inverse is J-covering. Present R as ofArrows Y f using Presieve.exists_eq_ofArrows and rewrite both images with Presieve.map_ofArrows. Set eta = e.unitIso.hom. Naturality gives eta(Y_i) followed by e.inverse(e(f_i)) equal to f_i followed by eta(W). Apply site_covering_isomorphic_family for J to the covering family g_i = e.inverse(e(f_i)), target isomorphism phi = eta(W), domain isomorphisms sigma_i = eta(Y_i), and new family f_i. Its final clause says ofArrows Y f is J-covering, which is R. No cohomology or sheaf equivalence is used.

theorem covering_iff_of_equivalence
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    (J : Precoverage C) (K : Precoverage D) [J.HasIsos]
    [J.IsStableUnderComposition] [J.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J.HasPullbacks]
    [K.HasIsos] [K.IsStableUnderComposition] [K.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    [K.HasPullbacks] (e : C ≌ D)
    (hcover : ∀ (W : C) (R : Presieve W), R ∈ J W →
      R.map e.functor ∈ K (e.functor.obj W))
    (hcover_inv : ∀ (V : D) (R : Presieve V), R ∈ K V →
      R.map e.inverse ∈ J (e.inverse.obj V)) :
    ∀ (W : C) (R : Presieve W), R ∈ J W ↔
      R.map e.functor ∈ K (e.functor.obj W)
